title: Scorer signature with parentheses in defaults fails to reload after save
answers: custom scorer fails to load after saving, invalid syntax in recreated function
scorer with tuple default argument cannot be loaded back
Failed to recreate function from source code SyntaxError with @scorer defaults
saved scorer with parentheses in default value or annotation won't load
body:
Symptom: A custom @scorer saves without error but cannot be loaded back. Loading fails with "Failed to recreate function from source code ... invalid syntax" when a default value contains a ")", e.g. keywords=("refund", "order") or a ")" string default.
Root cause: mlflow/genai/scorers/scorer_utils.py:recreate_function used re.match(r"\((.*?)\)", signature), which stops at the first ")" and truncated the parameter list.
Fix pattern: Parse the saved signature string with ast (ast.parse(f"def _f{signature}: pass"), nothing executed) and take the parameter text from ast.unparse(func_def.args). The logic lives in mlflow/genai/scorers/scorer_utils.py:_extract_params_from_signature, which recreate_function calls.
Constraints: Do not reintroduce regex matching on signature text for parameter extraction; nested parentheses, commas and quotes make it wrong. The return annotation is still dropped on reload, as before. Keep the signature parse non-executing.
applies: Applies to loading serialized custom scorers in mlflow/genai/scorers; does not cover other serialization paths.
says: Custom evaluation metric fails to reload after saving when default parameters contain tuples.
Saved model scorer throws invalid syntax error when restored into evaluation experiments.
Cannot load saved evaluation scorer whose default argument includes parentheses or list values.
Ensure custom generative AI scorers with complex default settings reload without errors.
search: Reloading saved custom scorers in mlflow/genai/scorers must parse signature parameters using the AST rather than regular expressions. In mlflow/genai/scorers/scorer_utils.py:recreate_function and _extract_params_from_signature, extract parameters by non-executing ast.parse and ast.unparse so default values containing parentheses do not truncate the parameter list. This guidance applies strictly to serialized custom scorer loading; return annotations are still dropped on reload, and regex matching on signature text must not be reintroduced.
